## Recall the Week

### What Happened Last Week?

> [!definition] Last Week's Experiences
>
> 1. Write key points from the week's recollections.
> 2. Write insights from trends arising from the above key points.

#### Key Points of Last Week's Experiences

- **Sunday Recount**:: The weekend was good and bad: good to see Shir and talk through my family issues and bad in that I was sick over the weekend.
- **Monday Recount**:: Sunday did not start well because I revised the week and day template instead of my morning routine. However the day got better as I performed my weekly review and preview. Sam and I saw Arielle and the kids in the evening in order for me to help Arielle with her back. Unfortunately, I also had some war memories after the friendly fire hostage incident.
- **Tuesday Recount**:: The day did not start well again because I worked on templates instead of my routines. However, I also found a good solution to the problem I was having with dv to md buttons. Later in the day, I got a call from Webselenese about a data analyst interview, which was exciting and a bit nerve racking.
- **Wednesday Recount**:: I started the day with my routines, which started the day off on a good note. Most of the day was really great because I just followed my learn drive while reviewing trigonometry. I felt like I loved learning again for the first time in a long time. Unfortunately, I became stressed later in the day when I realized my interview was the next day and I had not prepared, thankfully it was pushed off to Thursday.
- **Thursday Recount**:: The day went alright, but was filled with a little too much procrastination because of employment related anxiety. Thankfully, I practiced detachment and overcame the anxiety, giving me time to prepare for the interview before the Pidyon HaBen.
- **Friday Recount**:: The day before was primarily filled with the Webselenese interview and preparation, which all went very well.
- **Saturday Recount**::

#### Trends and Insight from Last Week's Experiences

> [!insight] My experiences from last week revolve around…

- **Weekly Recount**:: The week started off rocky with a couple days not started by routines.
- **Weekly Recount**:: Procrastination and detachment with learning and employment related tasks.
- **Weekly Recount**:: Preparation for the Webselenese interview, in which I performed well.

### From What Did I Detach Last Week?

> [!definition] Last Week's Detachment
>
> 1. Write key points from the week's detachments.
> 2. Write insights from trends arising from the above key points.

#### Key Points of Last Week's Detachments

- **Sunday Detachment Issue**:: Anxiety from starting the day late and feeling I will not finish what I want to do.
- **Sunday Detachment Solution**:: I acknowledge I made a mistake and accept that I can make my day better by doing my best with what I have.
- **Monday Detachment Issue**:: Negative thoughts about my family.
- **Monday Detachment Solution**:: I accept my family can be difficult and that is out of my control; however, I recognize that I have the power to lessen their effect on me.
- **Tuesday Detachment Issue**:: The day was going slowly because I was learning and following my learn drive, but I was not sure I should continue.
- **Tuesday Detachment Solution**:: I can and want to follow my learn drive, but I can also be aware of the time.
- **Tuesday Detachment Issue**:: I want to continue following my learn drive, but I am not sure if it would be best to get back to my schedule.
- **Tuesday Detachment Solution**:: It is important for me to follow my learn drive, but preparing for my interview was more pressing.
- **Wednesday Detachment Issue**:: Feeling anxious about the interview and procrastinating its preparation.
- **Wednesday Detachment Solution**:: The procrastination is due to employment anxieties and fears, but those reflect the past and I have the ability to change my future.
- **Thursday Detachment Issue**::
- **Thursday Detachment Solution**::
- **Friday Detachment Issue**::
- **Friday Detachment Solution**::
- **Saturday Detachment Issue**::
- **Saturday Detachment Solution**::

#### Trends and Insight from Last Week's Detachments

> [!insight] My detachments from last week revolve around…

- **Weekly Detachment Issue**:: Anxiety about starting my day late and having negative thoughts about my family.
- **Weekly Detachment Solution**:: I cannot control the past or others, but I can control my emotions and how I move forward.
- **Weekly Detachment Issue**:: Uncertainty about following my learn drive instead of my schedule.
- **Weekly Detachment Solution**:: When possible, follow my learn drive, but otherwise, remember the feeling and get excited to be able to get back to it another time.
- **Weekly Detachment Issue**:: Anxiety from employment and interviews.
- **Weekly Detachment Solution**:: My anxiety is based on the past, but I can create a better present.
